summary.value: Rosa Mexicano - Lincoln Center is a festive Mexican restaurant across from Lincoln Center on West 63rd Street.

description.value: Rosa Mexicano - Lincoln Center is an upscale Mexican restaurant at 44 W 63rd St, inside the Empire Hotel. It is famous for guacamole made tableside and pomegranate margaritas. Fiesta Hour runs weekdays from 4 to 7pm at the bar, which suits a pre-show bite.
